definitions.explanation: One's standing or rank in society, an organization, or a hierarchy.

examples.japanese: {高|たか}い{地位|ちい}に{就|つ}く。
{社会的|しゃかいてき}{地位|ちい}を{気|き}にする。
examples.english: To care about one's social status.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}の{地位|ちい}が{向上|こうじょう}した。
examples.english: The status of women has improved.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地位|ちい}に{就|つ}く (to assume a position)
- {地位|ちい}を{得|え}る (to obtain a position)
- {地位|ちい}を{失|うしな}う (to lose one's position)
- {地位|ちい}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い (high/low status)
- {社会的|しゃかいてき}{地位|ちい} (social status)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地位|ちい}: Status, position (social hierarchy)
- {立場|たちば}: Position, standpoint (perspective/situation)
- {身分|みぶん}: Status, identity (social standing)
- {役職|やくしょく}: Post, position (job title)
